In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the coherent electron transfer dynamics is a very complex phenomenon and that it is not possible to give an unambiguous interpretation of the experimental results.

the coherent electron transfer dynamics is a result of the quantum nature of the electron and the nuclear wave packet motion, while the coherent nuclear wave packet motions are a result of the coherent dynamics of the nuclear wave packets.
the coherent processes are a manifestation of the wave nature of electrons in the initial stage of the electron transfer in the B- and A-branches of the triple mutant RCs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the electron transfer in the A-branch of the mutant is slowed by the incorporation of mutations, while the electron transfer in B-branch is accelerated, and the electron transfer from β to HB is reversible in the mutant RCs.
the femtosecond stage in the electron transfer is a coherent process, which is determined by the mutual orientation of energy levels of the charge separated states and by the structure of the RC.

the coherent electron transfer in the initial phase of electron transfer in RCs of R. sphaeroids is a general property of the reaction centers of purple bacteria and is independent on the presence of water molecule HOH55.
